conditions.label: Actual contribution, audience and alternatives
conditions.required_treatment: Name the useful decision/use, eligible audience and closest existing alternative before selecting scope. Do not infer a paid gap or participation from provider visibility.

conditions.label: Partial work, rescheduling and exact reuse
conditions.required_treatment: Preserve attributable incurred hours and required remaining work by task/state. Reuse only genuinely retained work and do not treat changed dates as full duplicate tasks.

conditions.label: Concurrent roles and capable coverage
conditions.required_treatment: Map necessary overlapping duties to actual people/time. Count body-time once and separately test coverage; check package inclusions before later labour valuation.

conditions.label: Chosen participation and output mode
conditions.required_treatment: Agree actual audience, confidentiality and usable output. If adopting the named Chatham House Rule, respect its recording/AI/photo restrictions. Recording permission is not a default route around that mode.

conditions.label: Menu/venue eligibility and charge basis
conditions.required_treatment: Test applicable lower/upper menu/room conditions and actual billed covers, charges and inclusions. Neither a seat ceiling nor a dated menu establishes future suitability/price.

conditions.label: Cohort, format, locality and travel
conditions.required_treatment: Scope genuine cohort/mode/location changes, travel origins/payers and local resources. Shared research does not make international event operations identical.

conditions.label: Supplier liability, credit, cash and remaining service
conditions.required_treatment: Carry supplier liability, deposits, restricted future credits, actual refunds and unfulfilled benefits separately into dated cash and resource schedules.
